messages:
maria_support: PSA: Novus (novus-231) reports ~12 objects with custom_retention=604800s (7d) showing up in search after expiry. Delete API returns 202 and tombstone created, but objects still searchable. They need confirmation for purge timeline for compliance. Example call:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/batch_delete" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"ids":["obj_1A2b3C"],"policy_id":"cust-7d"}'

maria_support: Also their audit export shows no "delete_confirmed" event for those ids.

kevin_infra: Can you paste one object id + root_policy_id and the timestamp range?

maria_support: obj_1A2b3C, policy=cust-7d, created=2599900000, expired=2599960000. Attached minimal repro steps.

sanjay_sre: looking at the deletion-queue logs for obj_1A2b3C: 

[2026-08-15T12:23:40Z] tombstone enqueued id=obj_1A2b3C
[2026-08-15T12:24:01Z] purge_worker started id=obj_1A2b3C
[2026-08-15T12:24:02Z] kms_decrypt failed id=obj_1A2b3C error=HSM_SESSION_TIMEOUT code=403
[2026-08-15T12:24:02Z] purge_worker retry id=obj_1A2b3C attempt=1

sanjay_sre: HSM sessions were saturated during that minute due to a large key_rotation job. That caused the delete to be deferred and tombstone to survive until next GC. I'm going to check if tombstones reprocessed.

kevin_infra: I see deletion-queue lag spiked (backlog ~4500) after indexer v2 rollout. The queue backlog caused some tombstones to be visible in the search index because indexer and search-reconciler were out of sync.

maria_support: Customer claims audit logs show no "purge_success" events and legal team is asking for a retention confirmation within 24h. They may escalate to litigation preserve if we can't confirm.

elena_legal: place immediate legal hold on novus-231 objects if possible. Also need full audit export for object ids and KMS operation logs for the timeframe. cc:security.

kevin_infra: Action plan:
- pause automatic tombstone expiry for account novus-231 (flag: retention.hold=manual) ✅
- requeue failed tombstones and force purge worker with fallback key path (requires ops approval) 🔁
- produce audit export: events.delete_request, events.purge_attempt, kms.ops for 2599959000-2599970000

maria_support: Please confirm ETA for purge and export. Customer expects note to legal ops by EOD PST.

sanjay_sre: ETA: I can requeue and run force purge in ~90m if ops approves fallback key. Purge script:

```
python tools/purge_force.py --account novus-231 --ids obj_1A2b3C --use-fallback-key
```

kevin_infra: Ops approval granted (via thread ops-approve). Fallback key will be used; note this will emit kms_decrypt with key=fallback and produce audit entries.

retain-bot: legal_hold created for novus-231 by elena_legal at 2599991205

sanjay_sre: started force purge, monitoring logs. If purge succeeds we'll push index reconciliation and then trigger customer-facing confirmation.

maria_support: Thanks. One more note: billing showed an invoice failure for novus-231 around 2599955000 which triggered account state=SUSPENDED and a retention-fallback to org_default=180d — this may explain why some new objects inherited longer retention; investigating.

kevin_infra: confirmed. Billing-suspend path toggles policy resolution to org_default until billing fixed. That should NOT delay deletes but could change expected expiry windows. We'll include that in postmortem.

sanjay_sre: purge succeeded for obj_1A2b3C at 2599991320. Logs:
[2026-08-15T12:35:20Z] purge_success id=obj_1A2b3C key=fallback audit_id=az-9932
[2026-08-15T12:35:22Z] index_reconcile queued id=obj_1A2b3C

sanjay_sre: index reconcile completed, search no longer returns obj_1A2b3C. I'll compile audit export.

elena_legal: Received. Please send export and confirmation to legal@novus.com and cc ops.

maria_support: Noted. Sending customer update: purge confirmed, audit export to follow within 2 hours. :thumbsup:

kevin_infra: followups: schedule fix to prevent KMS rotation overlapping purge windows, add alert for deletion-queue backlog >1000, and ensure billing suspend doesn't remap policies in a way that confuses compliance teams.

maria_support: closing loop here. Thanks all. :tada:
